case_number: 2025 INSC 299; Criminal Appeal No. ____ / 2025 (Arising out of SLP (Crl.) No. 17281 / 2024)
summary: Custody dispute over US citizen with cerebral palsy; Idaho court granted permanent guardianship to mother; father brought son to India without consent; Madras HC denied habeas corpus citing son's willingness to stay; SC upheld Idaho guardianship order, enforced return; interim custody to mother; non-compliance with SC directions constitutes contempt; best interests of person with disabilities upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Hague Convention on the Civil Aspects of International Child Abduction
Article 141 of the Constitution of India
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; Madras High Court judgment set aside; permanent guardianship of Sharmila Velamur recognized; V. Sanjay directed to hand over custody of Aadith Ramadorai to the appellant; Contempt Petition (C) No. 9/2025 listed for hearing on compliance.
